items.difficulty_reason: For a linearly topologized module M over a topological ring R with a countable fundamental system of neighbourhoods of 0 and a submodule N, the lemma asserts that the induced sequence of completions 0 -> N^ -> M^ -> (M/N)^ -> 0 is exact, that N^ is the closure of the image of N in M^, and that M^ -> (M/N)^ is open (statement lines 997-1010). The proof is displayed in full: exactness at the left and statement (2) are quoted from the closure lemma, the canonical map c : M^/N^ -> (M/N)^ is produced, completeness of M^/N^ and openness of M^ -> M^/N^ come from the quotient lemma, the universal property of completion yields the inverse map b, and b and c are mutually inverse because they agree on a dense subset (proof lines 1012-1022). The level is H2: the whole zig-zag of canonical maps is constructed and checked, no step is omitted.
